newsitem.title: UK: Old crop LIFFE wheat sold down amid stg strength.
newsitem.headline: Old crop LIFFE wheat sold down amid stg strength.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures came down on Thursday, as a record high sterling encouraged holders to liqudiate old crop positions, traders said.
Front month May was most active with 359 lots done of a total 722 on wheat. It last traded 1.75 stg lower at 96.25 stg. July last traded 1.90 stg lower at 99.00 on 214 lots.
But new crop contracts were much less hard hit, with November down 0.25 stg at 97.75 stg.
"New crop never made it on the downside very much," one trader said, citing strong support under the market.
Barley also fell, in thin volume. November was most active, with 27 of a total 30 lots. It last traded 0.50 stg lower at 94.50 stg.
